page_title: GIR 0-0 RAY | Girona v Rayo Vallecano 25/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+6' Yangel Herrera (Girona) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
90+6' The ball goes behind for a corner. Girona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+5' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Girona have a corner.
90+3' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) gets a yellow card. The referee Juan Martinez Munuera made the right call.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rayo Vallecano comes to nothing.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 74:26.
89' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Juan Martinez Munuera and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

89' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
88' The ball is out of play and Girona manage to earn a corner.

83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Yangel Herrera (Girona) was quite harsh and Juan Martinez Munuera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
82' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) gets on the end of a cross from Viktor Tsygankov, but his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
80' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.

80' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
78' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Sergio Camello is replaced by Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano).
78' David Lopez (Girona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
77' A cross from Daley Blind (Girona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

77' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
76' Neat passing move from Girona in order to create new attacking opportunities.
75' Substitution. Gabriel Misehouy (Girona) in, Yaser Asprilla out.
74' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Rayo Vallecano.

67' Here is a change. Abel Ruiz is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
67' Substitution. Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) replaces Bryan Gil.

66' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
65' Ivan Martin (Girona) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
64' Juan Martinez Munuera shows a yellow card to Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.

60' What a great touch by Yaser Asprilla (Girona)! He picks up a precise pass and produces a long-range shot, but his fabulous effort smashes off the right post!
58' Abel Ruiz (Girona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

53' The ball has crossed the sideline. Girona are taking a throw-in.

49' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
48' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Augusto Batalla to dive and make a save.
48' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) tackles a bit over-zealously and Juan Martinez Munuera blows for a foul. Girona win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
48' One of the Rayo Vallecano players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Girona.

45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

45' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

22' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. It's a throw-in for Rayo Vallecano.
20' It must be a yellow card. It is. Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
20' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul after Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) hacks down one of his opponents. Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick.

18' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
18' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
17' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
16' Arnau Martinez (Girona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
16' Juan Martinez Munuera blows for a foul after Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Girona.
15' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Girona will take a free kick.

14' Rayo Vallecano players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The linesman signals a throw-in for Girona.
12' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Juan Martinez Munuera blows for a foul. Girona are awarded the free kick.
11' Rayo Vallecano can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

11' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
9' The game is pretty dull as Girona are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
8' Abel Ruiz (Girona) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
8' Abel Ruiz (Girona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
7' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
